```{r}
#| label: setup
source("_setup.R")
opts_chunk$set(dpi = cfg$report_dpi)

stations <- cfg$tendency_stations
if (is.null(stations)) {
  stations <- sort_by_altitude(thermo, setdiff(unique(thermo$estacion), cfg$excluded_stations))
}
tend <- accumulated_change(thermo, cfg, stations = stations) %>%
  mutate(variable_lab = factor(variable_labels[variable], levels = variable_labels),
         station_lab = factor(station_label(estacion), levels = station_label(stations)))
```

Mean accumulated change ∂φ(τ) = φ(t + τ) − φ(t), τ = 0 to 120 min, of specific humidity (q), potential temperature (θ) and wind speed (U) after every 10-min record of `r cfg$year`, grouped by the classification of the record at `r main_lab` (fog, dew or no atmospheric water) and by the light condition at t (night: global radiation at `r main_lab` ≤ `r cfg$night_radiation_max` W m^−2^). Shaded bands show the 95% confidence interval of the mean; the change after 60 min (dotted line) equals the mean ∂φ/∂t in units per hour. These are means over records, as in Figures 8 and 9 of the manuscript.

# `r main_lab`

```{r}
#| label: main-station
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
plot_tendency_curves(tend %>% filter(estacion == cfg$main_station), variable_lab, luz)
```

# Along the transect

The classification and the light condition are always those of `r main_lab`; the change is computed with the variables of each station. `r if (any(cfg$reference_station %in% stations)) paste0("At ", ref_lab, " the wind speed is hourly, so its 10-min changes are mostly missing.") else ""`

```{r}
#| label: stations
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

titles <- c(q = "Specific humidity", theta = "Potential temperature", U = "Wind speed")
for (v in c("q", "theta", "U")) {
  cat("\n\n## ", titles[[v]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (l in c("Night", "Day")) {
    d <- tend %>% filter(variable == v, luz == l) %>%
      mutate(light = l)
    print(plot_tendency_curves(d, light, station_lab) +
            labs(y = parse(text = variable_labels[[v]])) +
            theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = -90)))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

# Mean diurnal cycle of the 1-h change at `r main_lab`

Mean change in the 60 min after each record, ∂φ = φ(t + 60 min) − φ(t), by hour of the record (UTC) and occurrence type. Hours with fewer than 10 records of a type are not shown.

```{r}
#| label: diurnal
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 7
plot_diurnal_tendency(diurnal_tendency(thermo, cfg))
```

# Values after 60 min

```{r}
#| label: table
tend %>%
  filter(lag_min == 60) %>%
  transmute(Station = station_lab, Variable = recode(variable, q = "q (g/kg)", theta = "θ (K)", U = "U (m/s)"),
            Light = luz, Occurrence = regimen,
            `Mean` = signif(media, 3), `95% CI` = paste0("[", signif(lo, 3), ", ", signif(hi, 3), "]"), n) %>%
  arrange(Variable, Light, Station, Occurrence) %>%
  kable()
```
